plaatsen.tekst: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
Thy cheeks are comely with rows of jewels, thy neck with chains
